summary: Iteration 9: Full testing of Skin Store feature for Speed Run game. All 8 backend API tests PASSED, all frontend UI elements verified. 10 purchasable skins with correct prices and bonus percentages implemented.
passed_tests: GET /api/skins/catalog - Returns all 10 skins with correct pricing (Diamond 5%/0.05 SOL, Gold 5%/0.05 SOL, Silver 4%/0.04 SOL, etc.)
GET /api/skins/owned/{wallet} - Returns empty array for new wallet
POST /api/skins/purchase - Rejects invalid skin ID (400 error)
POST /api/skins/purchase - Rejects wrong payment amount (400 error)
POST /api/skins/purchase - Successfully records purchase and returns bonus_percent
Pricing spec compliance - All 10 skins match original spec requirements
UI: Skin store button visible on Game page (pink/magenta Store icon)
UI: Skin store modal opens when clicking store button
UI: All 11 skins displayed (default Guardian + 10 purchasable)
UI: Rarity badges displayed (legendary, epic, rare, uncommon, common)
UI: Default Guardian skin selected/owned with checkmark
UI: SOL prices displayed for all purchasable skins
UI: Lock icons shown on unpurchased skins
UI: 'Connect your wallet to purchase' message for non-connected users
critical_code_review_comments: Skin store implementation is complete and functioning correctly
Skin bonus is applied to score calculation in game (skinBonus property in initGame())
Skin selection persisted to localStorage (bullpugSkin key)
Backend validates payment amount matches skin price before recording purchase
seed_data_creation: Test skin purchases created with TEST_ prefix wallet addresses
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 verified complete Skin Store feature: 1) Backend: GET /api/skins/catalog returns 10 skins with correct pricing and bonus percentages, 2) Backend: GET /api/skins/owned/{wallet} returns owned skins array, 3) Backend: POST /api/skins/purchase validates skin_id, amount_sol, prevents duplicates, 4) Frontend: Pink store icon button next to SPEED RUN title opens modal, 5) Frontend: All 11 skins displayed with rarity badges, prices, bonus %, lock icons, 6) Frontend: Default Guardian skin shown as selected/owned, 7) Game applies skin bonus to score calculation (skinBonus in initGame()), 8) Skin selection saved to localStorage (bullpugSkin key)

skin_store_ui.location: Game page - pink store icon next to title

game_integration.bonus_applied: skinBonus property in game state multiplies score
